description: Ministry of City Planing & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Yakgahapitiya, D/S/D Kundasale, Kandy District & two amendments to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1922/30 of 08.07.2015 & 1906/46 of 19.03.2015.
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a water supply project.
